title: 1815 Prairie's door gets its stone pediment, its stoop its newels
items: On the Sears house at 1815 Prairie, a stone pediment on two small carved brackets now stands over the front door, with a finial at its peak, as the old square-on photograph shows it.
The stoop's stone side walls now sweep down to a square newel at each foot, capped and topped with a ball, where they used to run straight down to the walk.
